text:
lauren: FYI the sample app onboarding flow just surfaced another confusing error string for auth failures — shows `Authentication failed` with no code or retry hint. users keep opening tickets. :(
kevin: ugh. Is that from the JS SDK or the go one?
lauren: go SDK in the quickstart. prints raw http body. JS returns a typed error object. parity gap.
chris: this is exactly the problem we discussed — we need a canonical error shape in the platform contract, not ad-hoc strings.
mia: +1. We should separate user-facing copy from machine fields. keep `message` short and `code` + `type` + `retry_hint` for programmatic handling.
kevin: proposal: platform error JSON -> `{ \"type\": \"AuthError\", \"code\": \"unauthorized\", \"message\": \"Invalid API key\", \"status\": 401, \"retryable\": false }`
chris: and for rate limits `{ \"type\": \"RateLimitError\", \"code\": \"rate_limit\", \"message\": \"Too many requests\", \"status\": 429, \"retry_after\": 12, \"retryable\": true }`
lauren: can we add a short `example` field too? like `example: \"check your API key in ENV\"` so sample apps can show a helpful hint during onboarding.
mia: prefer `hint` instead of `example` — hints are short, actionable, and optional. also add `scope` when applicable (e.g., project vs token).
kevin: implementation detail: SDKs should map HTTP statuses -> typed exceptions but preserve full body for advanced users. mapping table in our spec: 401->AuthError, 403->PermissionError, 404->NotFoundError, 409->ConflictError, 429->RateLimitError, 5xx->TransientError.
chris: +1 but keep a catch-all `APIError` base type. also add `internal_code` for platform-only debugging (non-user visible).
lauren: small product concern: onboarding UX shows raw `message` if `hint` missing. can we default to a generic, friendly copy in the console: \"We couldn't sign you in. Check your API key.\" so we don't leak raw internals to new users.
kevin: agree. SDKs should expose both `error.message` for display and a `user_message()` helper that falls back to our friendly copy if `hint` absent.
mia: test matrix: add sampleapp test that hits 401, 429, 500 and asserts SDK raises typed exceptions with the fields: `type, code, status, retryable, hint`
chris: also add a small linter in the CI that validates error shapes returned by staging endpoints. I can add a check in the smoke tests.
ops-bot: deploy #staging finished: roll/infra-service v3.4.1 — note: we flipped the error-formatter flag.
lauren: perfect timing. kevin can you coordinate a tiny PR to the go quickstart to parse the new shape and show `hint` in the CLI output? keeps onboarding tickets down.
kevin: on it. I'll add a minimal parsing layer and fallback UX, + update changelog.
lauren: thanks team. can we land the mapping table in the devex repo today so SDK maintainers can consume it?
mia: i'll draft the mapping doc and share a short checklist for SDKs (fields to expose, user_message helper, tests). aim to post in #devex by EOD. :rocket:
kevin: tagging @chris for the CI linter change once the doc lands.
chris: will take it.
lauren: if everyone 👍, i'll open a meta issue tying the sampleapp fix, the mapping doc, and the CI linter into one milestone.
kevin: 👍
mia: 👍
chris: 👍
lauren: closing loop — thanks!
